senses.gloss: m., only in pl. constr. הוֹשְׁנֵי פשתן flax-stalks in an intermediate station of preparation, contrad. to אֲנִיצֵי a. הוֹצְנֵי (v. אָנִיץ a. הוֹצֶן).
units: Succ. 12ᵇ בה׳ פ׳ איני יודע Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) if one covered the Succah with hosh’neh …, I do not know (whether or not the Succah is kasher).
Ib. וה׳ פשתן עצמן א״י מהן Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) nor do I know what hosh’ne … are (in which stage they are called so).
